coi_current.instructions: The certificate of insurance on file is dated within the last 12 months and lists coverage limits meeting the standard supplier requirement.

w9_on_file.instructions: A signed W-9 (or local equivalent tax form) is present in the file.

next_step.instructions: Given everything in the state, what should happen to this supplier onboarding case next?

criteria.APPROVE: all required documents are present and current; onboard the supplier
criteria.REQUEST_DOCS: one or more required documents are missing or expired; ask the supplier to submit them
criteria.ESCALATE: something in the state looks contradictory or unusual enough to need a human reviewer

risk_level.instructions: Rate the overall onboarding risk of this supplier given everything in the state.

levels.medium: minor gaps or an upcoming expiry, but nothing disqualifying
levels.high: missing critical documents, mismatched entity names, or other red flags
